description: Machine-readable index mapping RFC section 5 deterministic simulation headings to executable bootstrap fixtures.

sections.heading: 5.1 Numeric Model
sections.notes: All fixtures use integer-only canonical state, sorted-key JSON, SHA-256, integer fuel burns, integer HP, and integer coordinates. Thrust and weapon fixtures also exercise integer cost formulas.

sections.heading: 5.2 Coordinate System
sections.notes: Both fixtures use axial coordinates and line-of-sight/range checks over a same-r row with distance 3 between agents.

sections.heading: 5.3 Map and Condition Profiles
sections.notes: Both fixtures include map definitions, explicit objects, constant-drift gravity, and map-level collision/gravity parameter overrides.

sections.heading: 5.3.1 Seed-Derived Map Generation
sections.notes: Both fixtures use explicit-materialized-v1 map definitions with seeds recorded as generation provenance. This gives deterministic seed/profile metadata while materializing generated objects for early clients.

sections.heading: 5.3.2 Parameter Overrides
sections.notes: Flat and velocity-based collision fixtures override gravity and collision parameters through map_definition.parameter_overrides.

sections.heading: 5.4 Object State
sections.notes: The LOS fixture has opaque blocker objects. The asteroid fixture has a colliding stationary object. The firing arc fixtures include ship facing for directional weapons.

sections.heading: 5.5 Movement
sections.notes: These cover inertial no-motion, active thrust changing velocity/position, constant-drift gravity movement, and a pass-by race with opposing velocities plus corrective thrust.

sections.heading: 5.6 Collision Resolution
sections.notes: These cover flat stationary collision damage and velocity-based stationary collision damage.

sections.heading: 5.7 Bootstrap Line-of-Sight Weapons
sections.notes: The both-armed fixture covers unblocked LOS damage. The blocked fixture covers opaque intermediate hexes preventing damage. The firing arc fixtures cover 360-degree out-of-range misses, fixed forward arc hits/misses, and a pass-by sequence where front, side, and rear engagement windows differ.
